name: Philately
description: A sheet of postage stamps on a dark album page: cream stamps with perforated edges, each holding a small colored picture of a sun, a peak, a star, a heart or a sailboat.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { --a: @p(0, 1, 2, 3); --b: @p(1, 2, 3); background: @p(var(--color1)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side, transparent 56%, #000 56%) -7.1429% -7.1429% / 12.5% 12.5%, linear-gradient(#000, #000) 50% 50% / 90% 90% no-repeat; mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side, transparent 56%, #000 56%) -7.1429% -7.1429% / 12.5% 12.5%, linear-gradient(#000, #000) 50% 50% / 90% 90% no-repeat; :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 15%; background: @match($(a) == 0, @p(var(--color2)), $(a) == 1, @p(var(--color3)), $(a) == 2, @p(var(--color4)), @p(var(--color5))); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 25%; background: @match($((a + b) % 4) == 0, @p(var(--color2)), $((a + b) % 4) == 1, @p(var(--color3)), $((a + b) % 4) == 2, @p(var(--color4)), @p(var(--color5))); -webkit-clip-path: @p(polygon(0% 100%, 0% 72%, 24% 34%, 42% 58%, 64% 18%, 100% 74%, 100% 100%), circle(42% at 50% 50%), @var(--star), polygon(50% 4%, 86% 62%, 96% 66%, 80% 90%, 20% 90%, 4% 66%, 50% 66%), @var(--heart)); clip-path: @p(polygon(0% 100%, 0% 72%, 24% 34%, 42% 58%, 64% 18%, 100% 74%, 100% 100%), circle(42% at 50% 50%), @var(--star), polygon(50% 4%, 86% 62%, 96% 66%, 80% 90%, 20% 90%, 4% 66%, 50% 66%), @var(--heart)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --star: @shape(star); --heart: @shape(heart); } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
